name: Blueprint View
author: neostryder
description:
A worked example of ModPlugin.frontend: it replaces the dungeon display with a drafting-table blueprint drawn from the WorldFrame's semantic layers - walls as strokes, floors as hatch, monsters and objects as marks - and never reads a terminal glyph.

It is a sample, not a way to play. Everything below the map (messages, the sidebar, every menu) is still the game's own screen; this owns the dungeon and nothing else.
